dialogues.speaker: Papar
dialogues.text: Cheers! Haaaaaayne, let's have another drink!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Who are you!? Did you just fall out of that tree?

dialogues.speaker: Papar
dialogues.text: It's me, Papar! Hayne, didn't we say we'd drink another round, eh? What a night! I'm so glad we met...

dialogues.speaker: Papar
dialogues.text: Uhm...? Hmm...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ugh...?

dialogues.speaker: Papar
dialogues.text: Hayne... Why are there two of you now? One tall... one short...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I think you've mistaken us for someone else!

dialogues.speaker: Papar
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Papar
dialogues.text: Hayne! Where are you? Let's keep drin... *hic* drinking!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The drunkard who fell out of the tree staggers off into the distance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... That name does ring a bell somehow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think Pucli might be looking for you.

dialogues.speaker: Papar
dialogues.text: P—Pucli? Oh no! He's not covering for me, is he!? I'm so dead... Thanks for reminding me!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The drunkard who fell out of the tree suddenly sobers up and rushes off into the distance.
